verses.original: וַיָּבִ֙יאוּ֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיַּצִּ֣יגוּ אֹת֔וֹ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָאֹ֔הֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר דָּוִ֑יד נָֽטָה־ ל֖וֹ וַיַּקְרִ֛יבוּ עֹל֥וֹת וּשְׁלָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇî·’ū ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yaṣ·ṣî·ḡū ’ō·ṯōw bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·’ō·hel ’ă·šer dā·wîḏ nā·ṭāh- lōw way·yaq·rî·ḇū ‘ō·lō·wṯ ū·šə·lā·mîm lip̄·nê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: So they brought - the ark of God and placed - it inside the tent that David had pitched for it And they presented burnt offerings and peace offerings before God

verses.original: דָּוִ֔יד וַיְכַ֣ל מֵהַעֲל֥וֹת הָעֹלָ֖ה וְהַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wîḏ way·ḵal mê·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ hā·‘ō·lāh wə·haš·šə·lā·mîm way·ḇā·reḵ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām bə·šêm Yah·weh
verses.literal: When David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and peace offerings he blessed - the people in the name of the LORD

verses.original: וַיְחַלֵּק֙ לְכָל־ אִ֣ישׁ מֵאִ֖ישׁ וְעַד־ אִשָּׁ֑ה לְאִישׁ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּכַּר־ לֶ֔חֶם וְאֶשְׁפָּ֖ר וַאֲשִׁישָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥal·lêq lə·ḵāl ’îš mê·’îš wə·‘aḏ- ’iš·šāh lə·’îš yiś·rā·’êl kik·kar- le·ḥem wə·’eš·pār wa·’ă·šî·šāh
verses.literal: Then he distributed to every . . . man and woman . . . of Israel a loaf of bread a date cake and a raisin cake

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֞ן מִן־ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם מְשָׁרְתִ֑ים לִפְנֵ֨י אֲר֧וֹן יְהוָ֛ה וּלְהַזְכִּיר֙ וּלְהוֹד֣וֹת וּלְהַלֵּ֔ל לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên min- hal·wî·yim mə·šā·rə·ṯîm lip̄·nê ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh ū·lə·haz·kîr ū·lə·hō·w·ḏō·wṯ ū·lə·hal·lêl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: David appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD to celebrate to give thanks and to praise the LORD the God of Israel

verses.original: אָסָ֥ף הָרֹ֖אשׁ זְכַרְיָ֑ה וּמִשְׁנֵ֣הוּ יְעִיאֵ֡ל וּשְׁמִֽירָמ֡וֹת וִֽיחִיאֵ֡ל וּמַתִּתְיָ֡ה וֶאֱלִיאָ֡ב וּבְנָיָהוּ֩ וְעֹבֵ֨ד אֱדֹ֜ם וִֽיעִיאֵ֗ל בִּכְלֵ֤י נְבָלִים֙ וּבְכִנֹּר֔וֹת וְאָסָ֖ף מַשְׁמִֽיעַ׃ בַּֽמְצִלְתַּ֥יִם
verses.transliteration: ’ā·sāp̄ hā·rōš zə·ḵar·yāh ū·miš·nê·hū yə·‘î·’êl ū·šə·mî·rā·mō·wṯ wî·ḥî·’êl ū·mat·tiṯ·yāh we·’ĕ·lî·’āḇ ū·ḇə·nā·yā·hū wə·‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm wî·‘î·’êl biḵ·lê nə·ḇā·lîm ū·ḇə·ḵin·nō·rō·wṯ wə·’ā·sāp̄ maš·mî·a‘ bam·ṣil·ta·yim
verses.literal: Asaph was the chief Zechariah was second [then] Jeiel Shemiramoth Jehiel Mattithiah Eliab Benaiah vvv Obed-edom and Jeiel . . . They were to play the harps and lyres while Asaph sounded the cymbals

verses.original: הַכֹּהֲנִ֑ים וּבְנָיָ֥הוּ וְיַחֲזִיאֵ֖ל בַּחֲצֹצְר֣וֹת תָּמִ֔יד לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hă·nîm ū·ḇə·nā·yā·hū wə·ya·ḥă·zî·’êl ba·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ tā·mîḏ lip̄·nê ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God

verses.original: הַה֗וּא אָ֣ז בַּיּ֣וֹם דָּוִיד֙ בָּרֹ֔אשׁ נָתַ֤ן בְּיַד־ אָסָ֖ף וְאֶחָֽיו׃פ לְהֹד֖וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: ha·hū ’āz bay·yō·wm dā·wîḏ bā·rōš nā·ṯan bə·yaḏ- ’ā·sāp̄ wə·’e·ḥāw lə·hō·ḏō·wṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: On that . . . day David first committed to Asaph and his associates [this song] of thanksgiving to the LORD

verses.original: הוֹד֤וּ לַֽיהוָה֙ קִרְא֣וּ בִשְׁמ֔וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ עֲלִילֹתָֽיו׃ בָעַמִּ֖ים
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh qir·’ū ḇiš·mōw hō·w·ḏî·‘ū ‘ă·lî·lō·ṯāw ḇā·‘am·mîm
verses.literal: Give thanks to the LORD call upon His name make known His deeds among the nations

verses.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ לוֹ֙ זַמְּרוּ־ ל֔וֹ שִׂ֖יחוּ בְּכָל־ נִפְלְאֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: šî·rū lōw zam·mə·rū- lōw śî·ḥū bə·ḵāl nip̄·lə·’ō·ṯāw
verses.literal: Sing to Him sing praises to Him tell of all His wonders

verses.original: הִֽתְהַֽלְלוּ֙ קָדְשׁ֔וֹ בְּשֵׁ֣ם לֵ֖ב מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ יִשְׂמַ֕ח
verses.transliteration: hiṯ·hal·lū qā·ḏə·šōw bə·šêm lêḇ mə·ḇaq·šê Yah·weh yiś·maḥ
verses.literal: Glory in His holy name let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֤וּ יְהוָה֙ וְעֻזּ֔וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֥וּ פָנָ֖יו תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: dir·šū Yah·weh wə·‘uz·zōw baq·qə·šū p̄ā·nāw tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: Seek out the LORD and His strength seek His face always

verses.original: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאֹתָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה מֹפְתָ֖יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־ פִֽיהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ziḵ·rū nip̄·lə·’ō·ṯāw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh mō·p̄ə·ṯāw ū·miš·pə·ṭê- p̄î·hū
verses.literal: Remember the wonders - He has done His marvels and the judgments He has pronounced

verses.original: זֶ֚רַע עַבְדּ֔וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּנֵ֥י יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּחִירָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ze·ra‘ ‘aḇ·dōw yiś·rā·’êl bə·nê ya·‘ă·qōḇ bə·ḥî·rāw
verses.literal: O offspring of His servant Israel O sons of Jacob His chosen ones

verses.original: ה֚וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו׃ בְּכָל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ
verses.transliteration: hū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū miš·pā·ṭāw bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: He is the LORD our God His judgments [carry] throughout the earth

verses.original: זִכְר֤וּ בְּרִית֔וֹ לְעוֹלָם֙ דָּבָ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה לְאֶ֥לֶף דּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ziḵ·rū bə·rî·ṯōw lə·‘ō·w·lām dā·ḇār ṣiw·wāh lə·’e·lep̄ dō·wr
verses.literal: Remember His covenant forever the word He ordained for a thousand generations

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּרַת֙ אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֔ם וּשְׁבוּעָת֖וֹ לְיִצְחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer kā·raṯ ’eṯ- ’aḇ·rā·hām ū·šə·ḇū·‘ā·ṯōw lə·yiṣ·ḥāq
verses.literal: [the covenant] He made with Abraham and the oath He swore to Isaac

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמִידֶ֤הָ לְיַעֲקֹב֙ לְחֹ֔ק לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עוֹלָֽם׃ בְּרִ֥ית
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mî·ḏe·hā lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ lə·ḥōq lə·yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·w·lām bə·rîṯ
verses.literal: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree to Israel as an everlasting covenant

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֗ר אֶתֵּ֣ן לְךָ֙ אֶֽרֶץ־ כְּנָ֔עַן חֶ֖בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lê·mōr ’et·tên lə·ḵā ’e·reṣ- kə·nā·‘an ḥe·ḇel na·ḥă·laṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: - I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance

verses.original: בִּֽהְיֽוֹתְכֶם֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר כִּמְעַ֖ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bih·yō·wṯ·ḵem mə·ṯê mis·pār kim·‘aṭ wə·ḡā·rîm bāh
verses.literal: When they were few in number few indeed and strangers in [the land]

verses.original: וַיִּֽתְהַלְּכוּ֙ מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל־ גּ֔וֹי וּמִמַּמְלָכָ֖ה אֶל־ עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·hal·lə·ḵū mig·gō·w ’el- gō·w ū·mim·mam·lā·ḵāh ’el- ‘am ’a·ḥêr
verses.literal: they wandered from nation to nation from [one] kingdom to . . . another

verses.original: הִנִּ֤יחַ לֹא־ לְאִישׁ֙ לְעָשְׁקָ֔ם וַיּ֥וֹכַח מְלָכִֽים׃ עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: hin·nî·aḥ lō- lə·’îš lə·‘ā·šə·qām way·yō·w·ḵaḥ mə·lā·ḵîm ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: He let no man oppress them He rebuked kings on their behalf

verses.original: אַֽל־ תִּגְּעוּ֙ בִּמְשִׁיחָ֔י אַל־ תָּרֵֽעוּ׃פ וּבִנְבִיאַ֖י
verses.transliteration: ’al- tig·gə·‘ū bim·šî·ḥāy ’al- tā·rê·‘ū ū·ḇin·ḇî·’ay
verses.literal: Do not touch My anointed ones Do no harm to My prophets

verses.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃ מִיּֽוֹם־ אֶל־ י֖וֹם
verses.transliteration: šî·rū Yah·weh kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ baś·śə·rū yə·šū·‘ā·ṯōw mî·yō·wm- ’el- yō·wm
verses.literal: Sing to the LORD all the earth Proclaim His salvation day after day

verses.original: סַפְּר֤וּ כְּבוֹד֔וֹ בַגּוֹיִם֙ אֶת־ נִפְלְאֹתָֽיו׃ בְּכָל־ הָעַמִּ֖ים
verses.transliteration: sap·pə·rū kə·ḇō·w·ḏōw ḇag·gō·w·yim ’eṯ- nip̄·lə·’ō·ṯāw bə·ḵāl hā·‘am·mîm
verses.literal: Declare His glory among the nations - His wonders among all peoples

verses.original: כִּי֩ גָד֨וֹל יְהוָ֤ה מְאֹ֔ד וּמְהֻלָּל֙ ה֖וּא וְנוֹרָ֥א עַל־ כָּל־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḡā·ḏō·wl Yah·weh mə·’ōḏ ū·mə·hul·lāl hū wə·nō·w·rā ‘al- kāl- ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: For great is the LORD and greatly to be praised He is to be feared . . . above all gods

verses.original: כִּ֠י כָּל־ אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָעַמִּים֙ אֱלִילִ֔ים וַיהוָ֖ה עָשָֽׂה׃ שָׁמַ֥יִם
verses.transliteration: kî kāl- ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·‘am·mîm ’ĕ·lî·lîm Yah·weh ‘ā·śāh šā·ma·yim
verses.literal: For all the gods of the nations are idols but [it is] the LORD who made the heavens

verses.original: ה֤וֹד וְהָדָר֙ לְפָנָ֔יו עֹ֥ז וְחֶדְוָ֖ה בִּמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·wḏ wə·hā·ḏār lə·p̄ā·nāw ‘ōz wə·ḥeḏ·wāh bim·qō·mōw
verses.literal: Splendor and majesty are before Him strength and joy fill His dwelling

verses.original: הָב֤וּ לַֽיהוָה֙ מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֔ים הָב֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇū Yah·weh miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ ‘am·mîm hā·ḇū Yah·weh kā·ḇō·wḏ wā·‘ōz
verses.literal: Ascribe to the LORD O families of the nations ascribe to the LORD glory and strength

verses.original: הָב֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂא֤וּ מִנְחָה֙ וּבֹ֣אוּ לְפָנָ֔יו הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה בְּהַדְרַת־ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇū Yah·weh kə·ḇō·wḏ šə·mōw śə·’ū min·ḥāh ū·ḇō·’ū lə·p̄ā·nāw hiš·ta·ḥă·wū Yah·weh bə·haḏ·raṯ- qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: Ascribe to the LORD the glory [due] His name bring an offering and come before Him Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness

verses.original: חִ֤ילוּ מִלְּפָנָיו֙ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אַף־ תֵּבֵ֖ל תִּכּ֥וֹן בַּל־ תִּמּֽוֹט׃
verses.transliteration: ḥî·lū mil·lə·p̄ā·nāw kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ap̄- tê·ḇêl tik·kō·wn bal- tim·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: tremble before Him all the earth . . . The world is firmly established it cannot be moved

verses.original: הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ יִשְׂמְח֤וּ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְתָגֵ֣ל וְיֹאמְר֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה מָלָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šā·ma·yim yiś·mə·ḥū hā·’ā·reṣ wə·ṯā·ḡêl wə·yō·mə·rū ḇag·gō·w·yim Yah·weh mā·lāḵ
verses.literal: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice Let them say among the nations The LORD reigns

verses.original: הַיָּם֙ יִרְעַ֤ם וּמְלוֹא֔וֹ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה יַעֲלֹ֥ץ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yām yir·‘am ū·mə·lō·w·’ōw haś·śā·ḏeh ya·‘ă·lōṣ wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer- bōw
verses.literal: Let the sea resound and all that fills it let the fields exult and all that [is] in them

verses.original: אָ֥ז עֲצֵ֣י הַיָּ֑עַר יְרַנְּנ֖וּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כִּי־ בָ֖א לִשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz ‘ă·ṣê hay·yā·‘ar yə·ran·nə·nū mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh kî- ḇā liš·pō·wṭ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD for He is coming to judge - the earth

verses.original: הוֹד֤וּ לַיהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh kî ṭō·wḇ kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Give thanks to the LORD for He is good . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וְאִמְר֕וּ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֙נוּ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֔נוּ וְקַבְּצֵ֥נוּ וְהַצִּילֵ֖נוּ מִן־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם לְהֹדוֹת֙ קָדְשֶׁ֔ךָ לְשֵׁ֣ם לְהִשְׁתַּבֵּ֖חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im·rū hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nū ’ĕ·lō·hê yiš·‘ê·nū wə·qab·bə·ṣê·nū wə·haṣ·ṣî·lê·nū min- hag·gō·w·yim lə·hō·ḏō·wṯ qāḏ·še·ḵā lə·šêm lə·hiš·tab·bê·aḥ biṯ·hil·lā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Then cry out Save us O God of our salvation gather and deliver us from the nations that we may give thanks to Your holy name that we may glory in Your praise

verses.original: בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִן־ הָעוֹלָ֖ם וְעַ֣ד הָעֹלָ֑ם כָל־ הָעָם֙ וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אָמֵ֔ן וְהַלֵּ֖ל לַֽיהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl min- hā·‘ō·w·lām wə·‘aḏ hā·‘ō·lām ḵāl hā·‘ām way·yō·mə·rū ’ā·mên wə·hal·lêl Yah·weh
verses.literal: Blessed [be] the LORD the God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting Then all the people said Amen and “Praise the LORD

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲזָב־ לְאָסָ֖ף וּלְאֶחָ֑יו שָׁ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֔ה לְשָׁרֵ֞ת לִפְנֵ֧י הָאָר֛וֹן תָּמִ֖יד י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃ לִדְבַר־
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·zāḇ- lə·’ā·sāp̄ ū·lə·’e·ḥāw šām lip̄·nê ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh lə·šā·rêṯ lip̄·nê hā·’ā·rō·wn tā·mîḏ yō·wm bə·yō·w·mōw liḏ·ḇar-
verses.literal: So David left Asaph and his associates there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD to minister [there] . . . regularly according to the daily . . . requirements

verses.original: וְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם שִׁשִּׁ֣ים וּשְׁמוֹנָ֑ה וְעֹבֵ֨ד וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם אֱדֹ֧ם בֶּן־ יְדִית֛וּן וְחֹסָ֖ה לְשֹׁעֲרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm šiš·šîm ū·šə·mō·w·nāh wə·‘ō·ḇêḏ wa·’ă·ḥê·hem ’ĕ·ḏōm ben- yə·ḏî·ṯūn wə·ḥō·sāh lə·šō·‘ă·rîm
verses.literal: vvv along with Obed-edom and his sixty-eight . . . relatives Obed-edom son of Jeduthun and also Hosah were to be gatekeepers

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת׀ צָד֣וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְאֶחָיו֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה בַּבָּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּגִבְעֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ṣā·ḏō·wq hak·kō·hên wə·’e·ḥāw hak·kō·hă·nîm lip̄·nê miš·kan Yah·weh bab·bā·māh ’ă·šer bə·ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: And David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of the LORD at the high place - in Gibeon

verses.original: תָּמִ֖יד לְֽהַעֲלוֹת֩ עֹל֨וֹת לַיהוָ֜ה עַל־ מִזְבַּ֧ח הָעֹלָ֛ה לַבֹּ֣קֶר וְלָעָ֑רֶב וּלְכָל־ הַכָּתוּב֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: tā·mîḏ lə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ ‘ō·lō·wṯ Yah·weh ‘al- miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh lab·bō·qer wə·lā·‘ā·reḇ ū·lə·ḵāl- hak·kā·ṯūḇ bə·ṯō·w·raṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: to regularly present burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offerings morning and evening according to all that was written in the Law of the LORD which He had commanded . . . Israel to keep

verses.original: וְעִמָּהֶם֙ הֵימָ֣ן וִֽידוּת֔וּן וּשְׁאָר֙ הַבְּרוּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת לְהֹדוֹת֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·‘im·mā·hem hê·mān wî·ḏū·ṯūn ū·šə·’ār hab·bə·rū·rîm ’ă·šer niq·qə·ḇū bə·šê·mō·wṯ lə·hō·ḏō·wṯ Yah·weh kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: With them were Heman Jeduthun and the rest of those chosen - and designated by name to give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: הֵימָ֨ן וִֽידוּת֜וּן וְעִמָּהֶם֩ חֲצֹצְר֤וֹת וּמְצִלְתַּ֙יִם֙ לְמַשְׁמִיעִ֔ים וּכְלֵ֖י שִׁ֣יר הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וּבְנֵ֥י יְדוּת֖וּן לַשָּֽׁעַר׃
verses.transliteration: hê·mān wî·ḏū·ṯūn wə·‘im·mā·hem ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ ū·mə·ṣil·ta·yim lə·maš·mî·‘îm ū·ḵə·lê šîr hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·ḇə·nê yə·ḏū·ṯūn laš·šā·‘ar
verses.literal: Heman and Jeduthun had with them trumpets and cymbals for the music and instruments [for] the songs of God And the sons of Jeduthun were stationed at the gate

verses.original: כָל־ הָעָ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ לְבֵית֑וֹ דָּוִ֖יד וַיִּסֹּ֥ב לְבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת־ בֵּיתֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ḵāl hā·‘ām ’îš way·yê·lə·ḵū lə·ḇê·ṯōw dā·wîḏ way·yis·sōḇ lə·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then all the people . . . departed for their homes and David returned home to bless - his household
